data.title: PR-22 promotion-receipt skeleton: intent identity, before/after snapshots, gate_profile and NotYetEnforced, with anti-forgery verification

data.body:
[HIGH] Gate 12's record check reverses the required promotion order and makes an honest receipt unverifiable. RFC 0032 requires a ready transaction to keep receipt_generation pending, then compose and independently verify the receipt, then mark gate 12 passed. All profiles enforce gate 12, and the receipt vocabulary permits only passed or not_yet_enforced. Therefore this loop compares the required claim passed with the pre-promotion record pending and returns GateNotOnRecord(ReceiptGeneration). The success fixture conceals the cycle by using the test-only recorder to mark every enforced gate, including gate 12, passed before verification (crates/continuum-repair/src/receipt.rs:1221-1242, 1273-1291; crates/continuum-repair/src/transaction.rs:659-681). If production follows that order, gate 12 self-certifies before independent verification.

Fix: distinguish pre-promotion verification from historical verification. In the promotion path, compare gates 1-11 to the record, require gate 12 pending, verify the receipt, then record gate 12 passed atomically. Historical verification can require the promoted record and gate 12 passed. Add both sequence tests.

Risk-high checklist:
1. Failure modes: correct promotion always refuses; bypassing the refusal can self-certify an unverified receipt.
2. Edge cases: retry after verification, already-promoted historical verification, publication failure, and concurrent lineage loss.
3. Rollback: keep the transaction ready with gate 12 pending and publish nothing on any verification or publication failure.
4. Monitoring: alert on gate 12 passed without a linked successful verification result, and on published receipts whose transaction is not promoted.
5. Input validation: reject pre-promotion records where gate 12 is already passed, and reject historical receipts unless the transaction's promotion record binds that receipt.

data.reason: HIGH blocker: verify_skeleton requires receipt_generation already passed, but RFC 0032 requires receipt verification before gate 12 transitions from pending to passed. See th-86diki.
